userStories.title: Judge response includes a moments array with required fields
acceptanceCriteria: Judge prompt instructs the model to emit at most one moment per dim per session
Each moment includes dim_key, turn_index, quoted_excerpt (<=240 chars), why_it_lost_score (<=180 chars), suggested_alternative (<=220 chars), severity in {minor,moderate,major}
Sessions with no specific coachable lapse return an empty moments array

userStories.title: Substring-verify every quoted_excerpt against the source transcript
acceptanceCriteria: Whitespace-normalized excerpt MUST be a substring of the actual session transcript
Moments that fail the substring check are discarded (not persisted, not rendered)
A '[scorer] moment failed substring check' log line is emitted on each failure
No fuzzy or approximate match fallback is used
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Judge emits confidence (low/medium/high) and confidence_reason
acceptanceCriteria: Each session's judge output includes confidence in {low, medium, high}
Each session's judge output includes a one-sentence confidence_reason
Calibration instructions are present in the prompt as specified in Section 9.3

userStories.title: Persist surviving moments to the moments table after redaction
acceptanceCriteria: Each surviving moment is redacted before insert
moment_id is sha256(session.stable_id + dim_key + turn_index)[:16]
Inserts are upserts: re-judging a session replaces its moments deterministically
redacted=1 is set on rows that had at least one redaction applied
